address: Ground Floor, National Museum of Qatar, Museum Park Street, Doha, Qatar
bio: Beaming smiles greet you from behind the counter at this easy-going and friendly spot tucked away in the National Museum of Qatar. When it comes to ordering, start off with their arancini or ‘Dynamite shrimps’ then go traditional with keema, khabees and Chef Noof’s madrouba that’s made using a special recipe – and no visit here will be complete without the date cake. A great strawberry mojito or a cup from their vast array of speciality coffees will set you up nicely for your museum visit....
